title: Credo (Sermisy, Missa Tota pulchra es)
desc: Claudin de Sermisy, Missa Tota pulchra es, Credo, 1556. 4 voices (Tenor 1, Tenor 2, Tenor 3, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
